messages:
Alyssa: ok folks — kickoff for ACME marketplace onboarding. primary asks: account mapping for pub IDs, trial SKU behavior, IAM/KMS access, and a go-live CTA. anyone on infra side?
Ben: I can take the AWS/GCP pieces. do we have the publisher account IDs yet?
Carlos: ACME sent a spreadsheet. uploading now. fyi they want a 14-day trial SKU and separate billing SKU.
Alyssa: linking the sheet: https://acme.example.com/pub-ids.csv — please add a column for `redwood_account` and `trial_sku`
Carlos: added redwood_account=rw-acme-01 for AWS, rw-acme-01-gcp for GCP, and rw-acme-01-az for Azure.
Ben: ok for roles we need a publisher IAM role ARN pattern. propose: `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodMarketplacePublisher` and equivalent GCP service account `redwood-pub@acme-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
Luke (DevEx): for private offers we also need KMS key access; suggest we ask ACME for Key ARN + policy snippet. here's our template: `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodMarketplacePublisher"},"Action":"kms:Encrypt"}]}`
Jamie (Legal): heads-up — trial terms need EULA pointer and data handling clause. ACME must accept our marketplace addendum. I'll send the addendum doc.
Alyssa: thanks Jamie. can legal confirm whether the addendum allows telemetry opt-out for enterprise customers?
Jamie (Legal): yes — we added opt-out language. will attach a redline by EOD.
MarketplaceBot: checklist created: /marketplace/onboards/1718009999-acme with tasks [account-mapping, roles, kms, legal-addendum, packaging-artifacts]
Ben: packaging notes — we need a hero image (1024x512), 1-line description, 300-word long description, and trial metadata (trial_days=14). ACME ops to provide assets to `s3://redwood-marketplace-assets/acme/`
Carlos: quick question on billing mapping: ACME wants trials to convert automatically to paid after 14 days. does the marketplace support auto-convert?
Alyssa: AWS/Azure support trial entitlements that auto-convert via billing plan — GCP requires an explicit activation call. we'll document the flow in the onboarding sheet.
Luke (DevEx): I'll draft a sample activation webhook example for GCP: 
```
POST /marketplace/activate
Content-Type: application/json
{ "customer_id": "CUST-123", "offer_id": "ACME-TRIAL-001" }
```
Reply with 200 to confirm activation.
Carlos: ACME will need test sandbox access. ACME team please confirm service endpoints and sample keys.
Alyssa: action items: Ben (AWS/GCP roles + packaging), Carlos (assets + sandbox creds), Jamie (legal redline), Luke (activation webhook + runbook). I'll own orchestration and final Go/No-Go.
Ben: putting estimated ETA = EOD Thursday for roles + policy docs.
Carlos: assets expected by Wed.
Jamie (Legal): redline done by today 5pm PT.
Alyssa: great — can everyone react to this thread with :thumbsup: when you've added your updates to the onboarding sheet?
MarketplaceBot: reminder scheduled for 1718010000 to recheck open tasks.
Ben: :thumbsup:
Carlos: :thumbsup:
Jamie (Legal): :thumbsup:
Luke (DevEx): :thumbsup:
